verify.description: Run the frontend verification loop: pnpm check, pnpm lint, pnpm build

args.description: Optional: subset to run (check, lint, build)

verify.prompt: Run the frontend verification loop from the frontend/ directory and report each result: 1) pnpm check, 2) pnpm lint, 3) pnpm build. All three must pass. If the user specified a subset, run only that part.
